name: BTC-Anchored Vol
description: Use BTC's deep, efficient Kalshi market as a real-time vol forecast for ETH and SOL: fair ETH/SOL implied vol = BTC implied vol x the coins' vol ratio. When ETH/SOL's own implied vol is far above it, buy the favourite; far below, buy the underdog.
hypothesis: BTC's Kalshi implied vol is a forward-looking vol forecast that adapts to regime changes (what killed SOL VolFavorite in September); ETH/SOL traders price vol off recent moves. Wrong if the anchored forecast predicts ETH/SOL realized vol no better than HAR, or the deciles of iv/anchored-iv aren't positive at real fills in both halves.
next: Rejected at research: BTC implied vol adds nothing to the HAR forecast (out-of-sample R2 0.589 vs 0.587 ETH, 0.591 vs 0.588 SOL); the signal overlaps eth-volfav's 93-97%; the underdog side loses. Early-window fair-value and structural-bias screens also negative.
